title: Regular local fibre finrank dimension comparison
statement: For a finite type algebra over a field and a prime with separable residue field, the localization is regular local if and only if the finrank of the residue-field fibre of Kähler differentials equals the topological Krull dimension at the prime.

proof.text: Localize at q; S and R are Noetherian, and the residue field is finitely generated as a field over k by the residue classes of generators of S.
Identify ker(R -> K) with m and combine the quotient conormal exact sequence with separable-residue injectivity. The result is a short exact sequence of K-vector spaces.

The outer terms have finite dimensions e = dim_K(m/m^2) and t = trdeg_k K. Additivity in the short exact sequence gives fibre dimension e+t. Localization of differentials and tensor cancellation identify this with K tensor_S Omega[S/k].

The dimension-at-point formula gives d+t, where d=dim R is finite. Regularity is equivalent to e=d by the cotangent criterion. Injectivity of natural-number casts and cancellation of t show that fibre dimension equals point dimension exactly when R is regular.
